title: Vidish.Space - My Portfolio, But Make It Cool 🚀

sections.title: A Hero Section That’s Actually Heroic
sections.description:
Most portfolios have a boring header. Not this one.

The Hero Section of Vidish.Space is a visual treat, featuring:

  • 8 dynamic images (4 for light mode, 4 for dark mode) in a responsive grid.
  • A rain animation—because who doesn’t love aesthetic falling particles? ☔ (Orange in light mode, white in dark mode).
  • Buttons to control rain speed, because interactive elements are fun.
  • A dark/light mode toggle—so you can choose your vibe.

The animations are inspired by Aceternity UI but massively optimized (the original spiked memory up to 2GB—ouch!). Plus, all text uses the sleek Zain font for a consistent, modern look.

sections.title: The Timeline - Because My Journey Deserves Style
sections.description:
A plain text resume? Boring. That’s why the Timeline Section brings my education and work experience to life with:

  • Wobbled Cards (because static cards are too mainstream 🎭).
  • A highly customized Aceternity UI timeline, made responsive and polished.
  • Lottie animations sprinkled in to add a touch of motion magic ✨.

Whether it’s my school days, PwC internship, or current job at Société Générale, the timeline makes it all engaging.

sections.title: Showcasing Projects - Because My Work Deserves the Spotlight
sections.description:
The Projects Section is where my creations shine. It features:

  • 4 custom-built project cards—each representing one of my key projects.
  • Clicking a card opens a modal (built with Tailwind) displaying detailed project info.
  • Framer Motion animations for smooth scrolling and transitions.

It’s fully responsive, ensuring my projects look great on any screen size. 🚀

sections.title: Contact Me - Because Networking is Key
sections.description:
The Contact Me Section is where people can connect with me easily. It includes:

  • Links to my socials (GitHub, LinkedIn, etc.).
  • A skill box listing my technical abilities, complete with proficiency levels.
  • Lottie animations and icons for a smooth user experience.

Simple, clean, and effective. Just like a good portfolio should be. 💼

sections.title: Technical Details - The Power Behind the Page
sections.description:
Vidish.Space isn’t just about looks—it’s built on solid tech:

  • Frontend: React 18, with a heavy use of Tailwind for styling.
  • Animations: Framer Motion for smooth transitions and Lottie for interactive elements.
  • Dark/Light Mode: Fully integrated, with WEBP images instead of SVGs to prevent layout shifts.
  • Custom Design: Backgrounds sourced from MagicPattern.design, and AI-generated images from OpenArt.ai.

Built to be fast, smooth, and visually striking—because portfolios should be as impressive as the developer behind them. 😉
